title: 292. Nim Game

examples.explanation: These are the possible outcomes: 1. You remove 1 stone. Your friend removes 3 stones, including the last stone. Your friend wins. 2. You remove 2 stones. Your friend removes 2 stones, including the last stone. Your friend wins. 3. You remove 3 stones. Your friend removes the last stone. Your friend wins. In all outcomes, your friend wins.
